sql: SELECT g.id,v.make,v.model,g.code,g."yearFrom",g."yearTo",g."model3dKey" FROM "VehicleGeneration" g JOIN "Vehicle" v ON v.id=g."vehicleId" WHERE g."isPublished"=true AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "Vehicle3DRevision" r WHERE r."generationId"=g.id) ORDER BY v.make,v.model,g.code
currentSql: SELECT g.id,g."model3dKey" FROM "VehicleGeneration" g WHERE g."isPublished"=true AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "Vehicle3DRevision" r WHERE r.key=g."model3dKey")
